ABOUT EMERALD RESIDENCE 

Emerald Residence is a 7-storey residential building in Dubai Marina. A project of Vakson Real Estate, its construction started in 2004 and was completed in 2006. It offers 44 freehold apartments in 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configurations.

The building is located close to Dream Tower, Damac Waves and Yacht Bay. It is located within walking distance of the Dubai Marina Yacht Club. International restaurants, beach clubs and 5-star hotels are also near the building.
